description.value:
Trigger An ally in range dies

Traits Signal, auditory, emotion, mental, fortune

Every other ally in range immediately gains one Standing Reroll, as though from your Crescendo, lasting 1 minute. An ally can hold only one Standing Reroll at a time; an ally who already has one does not gain a second, and the duration does not refresh. This triggers on death, not on being reduced to 0 Hit Points or on being dying.
